description: Reads how far the build of the webinar on the connected site has come: a card with a bar, a percentage, the step running now, an honest remaining time, and the two links once it is done. Take it right after the build starts, for example "Is it there yet?" It only reads and changes nothing on the site. It needs the session id, and the campaign id when the chat built more than one webinar. Show the card while it runs, and do not start the build again: it is already running. Words hosts use: build status, progress, is it there yet, links

campaign_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out when this chat just built one.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_build_status
title: Read the build progress
